none: PAS NLM-BFFEA7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a copy of a two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed bust draped right, large eye. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, possibly blundered. Reverse inscription: [VICTO]RIAE DD AVGGQ NN. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.7mm, Weight:…
